fusions.name: Plate No Proof
fusions.desc: A hard cut that deals 34 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 25% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Charms Come Undone
fusions.desc: Throws a cold grey crescent that deals 12 damage, knocks the target back 2 tiles and leaves it [Suppressed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Shoulder
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is returned to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Grey Reaping Hook
fusions.desc: Conjures a cold-wrought reaping blade. It increases your weapon damage by 12%, every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds, and your armour rises by 5%.
